claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: AZ-10417808 is a caspase-3 inhibitor with no expected cytotoxic activity at 2.5 uM; caspase inhibition is cytoprotective rather than cytotoxic, so it should not kill cells in a pooled viability screen.
